decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (HOUNSLOW-0314-01, HOUNSLOW-0314-02,  HOUNSLOW-0314-03 and HOUNSLOW-0314-04 received on 12/03/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used for the external roller shutters hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The pallet store hereby permitted and shown in approved drawing HOUNSLOW-0314-04 shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before the expiration of 2 years from the date of this permission.
description: Installation of two roller shutter doors to the rear elevation of the warehouse and retrospective planning permission for the erection of single storey pallet store
